headers.comment: Bundles keep their filename across rebuilds -- deliberately, because the download link on the participant's setup page is fixed and a versioned name would leak which condition they are in. So the name cannot carry the cache key and revalidation has to. On the default hour, rebuilding a bundle mid-study means a participant can be handed an hour-old tool with nothing on screen to say so.
Without this the sign-in popup cannot close itself, and a successful sign-in reports an error.

Firebase's own auth machinery lives under /__/. Leave it exactly as Firebase serves it: the popup is one of these pages, and giving it a policy of our own is how you sever the thing you were trying to keep connected.
